name: primitives-animate-code-block
title: Animated Code Block
description: Animated code display that optionally types out code character-by-character. Supports Shiki syntax highlighting with light/dark theme variants. Emits callbacks during typing (onWrite) and on completion (onDone). Triggers animation when…
use: Tutorial pages or documentation showing how-to code examples with playful reveal.
avoid: Very long code files (1000+ lines): typing animation will run too long.
a11y: Code text is fully rendered in DOM, readable by screen readers. No aria-live for typing progress: final highlighted HTML is semantic.

props.name: onWrite
props.type: (info: {index: number; length: number; done: boolean}) => void
